name: AI Safeguarding and the 4Cs — CPD update after KCSIE 2026
description: A 30-minute self-paced CPD update for DSLs and whole-school staff in England on AI safeguarding and the 4Cs of online safety after Keeping Children Safe in Education 2026. 30 minutes (0.5 CPD hours).

criteria.narrative: Visit every lesson of the five modules (including three practice scenarios) and answer all five knowledge-check questions correctly. Learning outcomes: 1. Explain what KCSIE 2026 adds about AI within the 4Cs: content, contact, conduct and commerce. 2. Recognise AI-related risks: AI-generated nudes and semi-nudes, companion apps and chatbot disclosures. 3. Respond to a disclosure safely: no promise of secrecy, and never view, copy or investigate imagery. 4. Record the facts the same day and refer to the DSL, using back-up routes if the DSL is unavailable. 5. Signpost Report Remove, CEOP, Childline and the NSPCC Helpline appropriately.
